authority_limits: Native default items, durability-only data, healthy dry standing with default attributes and no received effects. Modified mining components/enchantments, fluids/unknown geometry and full player physics remain required later work.
Tool scheduling requires received block tags with target membership matching original default facts; missing membership is unavailable.
Exact received air is retained before later durability updates; earlier inventory or context changes remain latched. Original connection never grants continuation.
Each live case uses the same common consumer without a version branch, closes the original source, admits one fresh same offline UUID/name, rejects old IDs and places from fresh authority.
Local wait/model/tool gate is not actual elapsed server ticks, actor attribution, loot assurance or an acceptance ACK. RCON reads independently after fixed fixture, without further game-state edits.
